method: Sources: android/jadx-out/sources (default jadx) plus, for methods default jadx failed on ("Method not decompiled"), a throw-away `jadx 1.5.6 --decompilation-mode simple --show-bad-code --no-res` run of android/xapk/de.jung.junghome.apk into /tmp (same class names; cited lines are the default-tree file unless marked "simple-mode"). Kotlin names come from the "compiled from: X.kt" headers and from lambda class names (Outer$member$N). ID RULES (all mechanical, lowercase): prod:pid:<productId string lowercased, e.g. 0x000a> + prod:pid:other; prod:mini-actuator-type:enum; prod:actuator-function:<ActuatorFunctionId subclass name kebab-cased> (+unknown); prod:insert-type:<InsertType subclass kebab>; prod:layout:<LayoutMode constant kebab>; prod:key-mode:<suffix of the key_mode_* string resource>; prod:class:<Kotlin device class name kebab> (every file whose header is "compiled from: *Device.kt" or Gateway.kt and that extends Device); prod:led-palette:<device class kebab> (every A8.c colour list constant); prod:provider:<Kotlin provider file name kebab without -provider>; prod:param:<provider-short>:<literal cell key passed to InterfaceC1862s.* kebab-cased, "Parameter" suffix dropped>, provider-short = the Kotlin provider that defines the cell's property lambda (Outer$<name>Parameter$1) or builds it (LedColor headers); prod:param-gate:<fixed name> for the 4 cross-cutting cell mechanisms; prod:ui:<title string resource name of the control> for display-tab / other device screens, falling back to prod:ui:vm.<ViewModel kebab>.<method kebab> (ViewModel$method$1 lambda class) when the control has no own title string; prod:setup:<provisioning interactor kebab> for per-product writes/reads done automatically after provisioning; prod:unused-string:<resource name>. ENUMERATION (rerun recipe): (1) products: grep -rhoE '"0x00[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}"' sources (20 distinct pids 0x0001-0x000D, 0x0010-0x0016) and walk Y7/C0919h.java (DeviceMapper), io/grpc/u.java:D(), p089i0/c.java:x(), Y7/h0.java; names from app/ui/project/gateway/detail/z.java pid chain -> app/utils/o.java getString(device_name_*); firmware from resources/assets/updates/*_update.json product_id; pid-specific behaviour from every other file containing a pid literal (CheckForMissingDevices, UpdateDeviceViewModel, AbstractC0916e R1/K1, MiniActuatorDevice.f2, p023b8/b.java default layout, LampDetailActivity forced-off). (2) enums: ActuatorFunctionId, InsertType, LayoutMode (+ButtonLayoutViewModel$observeDeviceLayout$1 offered lists, app/utils/g.java labels), KeyMode p056e8/i.java (+key_mode_* strings), MiniActuatorType. (3) device classes: grep -l 'compiled from: [A-Za-z]*Device.kt' in Y7 Z7 p012a8 p023b8 domain/item/devices + Y7/g0.java; implements lists resolved to Kotlin interface names. (4) Parameters tab: list providers/ (ls | grep '\$' | sed 's/\$.*Parameter.*//' gives every <Provider>$<name>Parameter lambda) and grep -rnoE 'InterfaceC1862s\.[a-z]\("[A-Za-z]+"' in deviceParameter/ (default + simple-mode) for every cell key; provider lists from each provider's c() (normal d() / expert b()) and a(); DI registration in A6/e.java; cell conditions (instanceof capability interface, G(n) predicates in G.java), ranges and strings from C1859o/C/C1847c/C1849e/C1851g/C1854j/C1855k/C1857m/C1860p/H/I/M/z; wire format from the capability class toByteArray (J8/*, P8/*, p096i8/*) and p056e8/r.java property ids. (5) Display tab / other device screens: every ViewModel/Fragment under app/ui/devices/{blinds,controlSwitch,connection,detectors,lamp,miniActuator,rtr,socket,shared}, app/ui/configuration/{consumption,deviceInfo,scenes}, app/ui/timer/threshold and LockFunctionViewModelDelegate: grep 'CommunicateWithDevice.Params' (REQUEST f44924a / UPDATE f44925b) and domain interactors they call (ConfigureControlSwitchLayout, EnablePresenceTest/DisablePresenceTest, KeepLowPowerDeviceAwake, SetRtrPropertyConnection, SetLockingFunctionConnection, SetMultiConnection); labels from res/layout/*.xml @string refs of the matching layouts (fragment_*/view_*/activity_* named after blind, rtr, detector, mini_actuator, control_switch, socket, consumption, threshold, dim, tunable, device_info, switch_layout, locking_function, sleep_mode). (6) provisioning per-product writes: domain/interactors/configuration/{ConfigureDetector,ConfigureSocket,ResetOperationMode}. SECOND SWEEP (strings angle): index every R.string.<name> in default+simple trees and every @string/<name> in res/{layout*,navigation,menu,xml}; for all strings.xml names with prefixes device_parameter, blind, rtr, detector, mini_actuator, control_switch, lock_function, key_mode, switch_layout, device_name, socket, threshold, insert, input_edge, pir, consumption, led, night, boost, timekeeper, presence, hotel, operation_lock, temperature, wind, connection_temperature, puck, sensor, device_type, dim, stm32, battery, calibrat, wall, motion, frost, comfort, eco: used ones were checked to fall under an item above, unreferenced ones are listed as prod:unused-string:* (65). Class-name sweep (scriptable): (a) every <Provider>$<x>Parameter lambda and every literal cell key must occur in the file; (b) every file <X>ViewModel|Delegate$<method>$N in app/ui/{devices,configuration/consumption,configuration/deviceInfo,configuration/scenes,timer/threshold} whose method does not start with observe/special/state/get/is/internal/display/card/controlSwitchItem/selected/mapTo/startObserving/reload/requestGenericOnOffIfMissing (pure observers or on/off control) is cited by at least one item; (c) every R.string/@string name with the prefixes above ending in _title/_label/_label_text that is used in code must appear in some item (names are listed in each item's 'Strings:' suffix) - remaining exceptions: socket_preview_label (scene creation screen, other domain). All three checks pass for this file. Out of scope here (other domains): on/off, scene recall, group/central functions, timers/astro scheduler, OTA update, provisioning/network config, gateway REST. Nothing from our implementation is assessed. THIRD SWEEP (adversarial verification, onboarding angle): the classes under app/ui/addNewDevice/ were walked (ls app/ui/addNewDevice/*/ ; grep -n 'Activity.class' app/ui/shared/success/SuccessWithDelayActivity.java for the StartConfigurationDestinationArgument branch); every Activity in the product-class-specific subpackages {controlSwitch, miniActuator, timeKeeper} is one item prod:onboard:<Activity class name kebab-cased without the -activity suffix> (naming/ and deviceSetup/ are product-independent and belong to mgmt). Also re-checked with a strings-in-files angle: every R.string.<name> in app/ui/{devices,configuration,timer/threshold,addNewDevice,update/device}/** and every @string/<name> in the layouts those files inflate (R.layout.<name>) was matched against all docs/parity/inventory-*.json; after dropping common_*, add_devices*, *_description/_message/_sub_title/_subtitle/_text/_hint/_info names and names already in any inventory, the remainder is covered by an existing prod item's behaviour (gateway_connection_* -> prod:ui:control_switch_category_selection_gateway, set_rtr_connection_* -> prod:ui:rtr_connected_devices_explanation, threshold_* -> prod:ui:threshold_timer_label, expert_mode_* -> prod:param-gate:expert-mode, device_type_selection_*_header -> prod:ui:device_type_selection_title, lock_function_on/off_title -> prod:ui:connection_locking_function_list_subtitle, timer_astro_* and scheduler_* -> timers domain) except the three onboarding screens above. Every '*Compatible.kt' capability interface (grep -rl 'compiled from: [A-Za-z]*Compatible') and every '*Device.kt' class extending Device was cross-checked: nothing further.

items.title: Disabling-function key: time limit

items.title: Connect inputs (E1+E2 same function)
items.details: Mini actuators / pucks: toggle -> ButtonLayout ONE_ROCKER (connected) or ONE_TOP_ONE_BOTTOM (separate) via ConfigureControlSwitchLayout = Admin 0x5001 Set + node reset/re-provisioning (dialog: must carry out a restart). Strings: mini_actuator_connect_input_label_text, mini_actuator_connection_dialog_connect_title, mini_actuator_connection_dialog_disconnect_title.

items.title: Input function assignment (mini actuator E1/E2)
items.details: As key assignment (prod:ui:control_switch_category_selection_title) for inputs; page reads 0x5003 KeyMode and 0x5006 KeySetPropertyMode of each input element; IoT option texts mini_actuator_connection_iot_e1 / _e1_e2. Strings: mini_actuator_connection_category_title.

items.title: Edge evaluation (per input)
items.details: Per binary input element: Admin 0x5009 InputEdgeDetection, 1 byte = bits4:3 falling behaviour, bits2:1 rising behaviour, bit0 mode (EDGE 1 / STATE 0); default when unread: mode UNKNOWN->written as given, behaviours NO_REACTION. Read on page open (requestInputDetections). Strings: mini_actuator_input_edge_behaviour_label_text.

items.title: Pucks need a time keeper for automatic functions
items.details: Shown on the automations screen of a puck (0x0010-0x0016) when no time keeper exists in the project: pucks query the time from another device (switch actuator, socket, detector); resolved with prod:param:time-keeper:time-keeper. Nothing written by the dialog. Strings: mini_actuator_pp2_no_connection_dialog_text.

items.title: RTR Comfort / ECO / Frost protection mode
items.details: Admin 0x120B RtrHvacMode u8 COMFORT 1 / ECO 2 / FREEZE 3 (acked Set). SW < 2.2.0.0: the preset temperature is written as target instead.

items.title: RTR target temperature
items.details: Slider/buttons 5 .. 30 degC in 0.5 steps (debounced 500 ms): TargetTemperatureCapability = Generic Level Set on the set-point element with pct = round((t-5)/25*100).

items.title: RTR automatic operation (Auto/Manu)
items.details: Admin 0x1246 SchedulerEnabled u8 bool (toggle of the current value); read on open (status also via 0x1249).

items.title: RTR set-point: Comfort Temperature
items.details: Modes screen: 5 .. 30 degC in 0.5 steps; Admin 0x1203 TempComfort int16 LE in 0.01 degC; all three read on open. Strings: rtr_comfort_mode_title.

items.title: RTR linked (heating) devices
items.details: Link switch loads / sockets to the RTR: OnOff servers subscribe to the RTR element group + Admin 0x1014 RtrOperationMode = 1 on each load (0 on removal via RemoveMultiConnection / ResetOperationMode); linked loads then show the RTR-link info and disable timing parameters. Strings: rtr_connected_devices_explanation.

items.title: RTR actual temperature / display mode
items.details: Sensor Get 0x004F (x0.5 degC, clamped 5..30) on open; current/target display mode toggle is app-local.

items.title: RTR set-point: ECO-Mode
items.details: Modes screen: 5 .. 30 degC in 0.5 steps; Admin 0x1204 TempStandby (ECO) int16 LE in 0.01 degC; all three read on open. Strings: rtr_eco_mode_title.

items.title: RTR set-point: Frost protection temperature
items.details: Modes screen: 5 .. 30 degC in 0.5 steps; Admin 0x1205 TempFreeze int16 LE in 0.01 degC; all three read on open. Strings: rtr_frost_mode_title.

items.title: Current power
items.details: Metering socket 0x0003 / energy puck load: Sensor Get 0x0081 Active Power (x0.1 W), polled while the page is open.

items.title: Consumption views selection
items.details: App-local choice of which consumption views are shown under the socket diagram; nothing written.

items.title: Electricity cost (price per kWh)
items.details: App-local price (ct/kWh) used to show cost; nothing written.

items.title: Consumption chart 31 days
items.details: LBC User Property Get 0x5011 MonthlyEnergyChart (MeasureType THIRTY_ONE_DAYS): uint24 big-endian samples x0.1, entry i = i days ago, 0xFFFFFF invalid. Strings: socket_measure_type_31_day.

items.title: Consumption chart 24 h
items.details: LBC User Property Get 0x5010 DailyEnergyChart (MeasureType DAILY): uint16 big-endian samples x0.1, entry i = i hours ago, 0xFFFF invalid. Strings: socket_measure_type_daily.

items.title: Reset total consumption
items.details: Two acked SIG Generic Admin Property Sets (0x48): 0x006A [access 3][0 as int32 LE] and 0x006D [access 3][0]. Strings: socket_reset_total_consumption.

items.title: Total consumption and operating hours
items.details: SIG Generic Admin Property Get 0x006A TotalDeviceEnergyUse (Wh, shown /1000 kWh) and 0x006D TotalDevicePowerOnTime (h; metering socket only).

items.title: Info tab: STM32 version (RTR)
items.details: RtrDevice only: LBC Manufacturer property 0x0005 STM32Version, dotted decimal.

items.title: Operating concept (button layout) change
items.details: Control switches (0x0001/0x0002/0x0005/0x0006): pick a LayoutMode (1-gang: ONE_ROCKER, ONE_TOP_ONE_BOTTOM; 2-gang: ONE_LEFT_ONE_RIGHT, ONE_LEFT_TWO_RIGHT, TWO_LEFT_ONE_RIGHT, TWO_LEFT_TWO_RIGHT). ConfigureControlSwitchLayout: Admin 0x5001 ButtonLayout Set (uint16 LE, no wait for status), then ReprovisioningDevice (node reset + re-provisioning). Steps UpdateButtonLayout -> Reprovisioning -> Finished. Strings: switch_layout_header, switch_layout_info_dialog_title, switch_layout_type_1_1_possibilities, switch_layout_type_1_2_possibilities, switch_layout_type_2_1_possibilities, switch_layout_type_2_2_possibilities.

items.title: Power thresholds (turn on / turn off)
items.details: Metering socket only (ThresholdCompatible): "If <W> for <s> then switch devices ON/OFF". Admin 0x5004 TurnOnThreshold / 0x5005 TurnOffThreshold = [0x0081 u16][time u16 s][power u24 x0.1 W, 0xFFFFFF none][active u8] + publication of the socket OnOff client and subscription of the target devices (device-key). Strings: threshold_title, threshold_edit_title.

items.title: Colour temperature control (DALI page)
items.details: TunableWhiteLampDevice: wheel -> Light CTL Set, bounded by the device CTL temperature range read on open.

items.title: Info tab: update available link
items.details: Compares 0x001A (and STM32 0x0005 for RTR) with bundled/remote firmware versions; opens the OTA update flow (not mesh settings).

items.title: Blind position slider
items.details: Generic Level Set (percent, 100 % = closed) to the position element.

items.title: Slat position slider
items.details: Generic Level Set (percent) to the slat element; only for operation mode BLINDS.

items.title: Battery state of battery push-buttons
items.details: BatteryCompatible devices (0x0005, 0x0006): SIG Generic Battery Get on page open (waitForStatus=false); levels GOOD/LOW/CRITICAL/UNKNOWN shown as icons.

items.title: Favourite flag
items.details: App-local favourite marker on the device page; nothing written on the mesh.

items.title: Device name
items.details: App-local / project file name; nothing written on the mesh.

items.title: Battery state of the battery puck
items.details: Pid 0x0016: SIG Generic Battery Get on the input configuration page.

items.title: Post-provisioning push-button screen (ConfigureControlSwitchActivity)
items.details: Shown once after provisioning (SuccessWithDelayArgument.StartConfigurationDestinationArgument) for a ControlSwitchDevice that is not a battery wall transmitter (Z7.i 0x0005 / Z7.j 0x0006) or the battery puck (p023b8.c 0x0016) and whose InsertId actuator function is not Extension, i.e. the mains push-buttons 0x0001/0x0002 with a load insert. Lists the insert (attachment) and the app devices it produced (DeviceFilter.AttachmentWithInsert). On open it runs ConfigureControlSwitchFunctionality: the factory key wiring, one SetDeviceConnection.AddressParams per GetInitialControlSwitchPublication entry (key client publication/subscription + KeyMode 0x5003; the message sequence itself is net:uc:configurecontrolswitchfunctionality). OK opens the blind setup assistant (SetupAssistantActivity, prod:ui:blind_detail_parameter_operating_mode_title .. prod:ui:blind_reference_run_title) when a BlindDevice was produced, else device naming (ConfigureDevicesNameActivity). Strings: configure_control_switch_title, configure_control_switch_attachment_title, configure_control_switch_attachment_description.

items.title: Post-provisioning mini actuator / puck screen (MiniActuatorInfoActivity)
items.details: Shown once after provisioning any MiniActuatorDevice (0x0004, 0x000D, 0x0010-0x0016). Title configure_puck_title for pucks (R1()), configure_mini_actuator_blind_title when the load is a BlindDevice, else configure_mini_actuator_title; lists the input/sensor part (sensor_connection) and the node's lamp or blind devices (configure_single_device_title when there is no actuator). Nothing written. Next: forceBackNavigation -> back; K1() (puck with an actuator, 0x0010-0x0014) -> TimeKeeperInfoActivity (prod:onboard:time-keeper-info); a BlindDevice -> blind setup assistant (SetupAssistantActivity); else device naming. Strings: configure_puck_title, configure_mini_actuator_title, configure_mini_actuator_blind_title, configure_single_device_title, configure_control_switch_devices_title, sensor_connection, mini_actuator_configuration_description, mini_actuator_configuration_no_actuator_description, mini_actuator_configuration_description_lamp_placeholder, mini_actuator_configuration_description_lamps_placeholder, mini_actuator_configuration_description_blind_placeholder, device_type_lamp_name, device_type_blind_name.

items.title: Post-provisioning puck time-keeper info (TimeKeeperInfoActivity)
items.details: Opened from prod:onboard:mini-actuator-info for every newly provisioned puck with an actuator (K1(), 0x0010-0x0014), whether or not the project already has a time source: the puck needs another device to query the time, without it no automations; lists the possible sources (switch actuator mini, socket, motion/presence detector, push-button 1-/2-gang, room thermostat). The screen state carries the node's BlindDevice id when there is one (TimeKeeperInfoViewModel) for the next step. Nothing written; the time source itself is prod:param:time-keeper:time-keeper. Strings (texts also listed as mgmt:str:*): configuration_time_keeper_info_headline, configuration_time_keeper_info_title_1, configuration_time_keeper_info_description_1, configuration_time_keeper_info_title_2, configuration_time_keeper_info_description_2, configuration_time_keeper_info_mini_actuator_device, configuration_time_keeper_info_socket_device, configuration_time_keeper_info_motion_detector_device, configuration_time_keeper_info_switch_device, configuration_time_keeper_info_motion_rtr_device.
